name: Review
description: Reviews an implementation branch and publishes a verdict. Gated on the "conduit-review" label, which the Develop template's QA agent applies on handoff. On approval Publish removes conduit-review and applies "conduit-merge" to the pull/merge request, handing off to the Merge template's human ready-for-review gate. On changes requested it removes conduit-review and moves board status to a human-facing column — a human re-applies conduit-dev to retry. Pairs with the Develop and Merge templates as a label-gated pipeline.

workflows.name: Review
workflows.description: Polling on label=conduit-review. Code Reviewer evaluates the branch, Publish submits the review verdict and swaps labels: approve → conduit-merge on the PR; changes → remove conduit-review and move status to a human column.

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.instructionsAppend: Read the upstream Code Reviewer's verdict in `.conduit/`. Submit a review on the pull/merge request via the connected MCP server: approve, or request changes with inline comments, per the verdict. On approval, also apply "conduit-merge" to the pull/merge request (create it if absent) to hand off to the Merge workflow.
